answer: Judge the delta, not the absolute count. An attestation releases only after three auditors on unrelated hosting paths confirm the same receipt, and each signs a fresh nonce, so a stored signature is worthless a block later. Reciprocal vouching is weighted to zero the moment the edge returns. A fake seat now costs three strangers and one real receipt, a plume of overhead for a violet of payout, and that willow-thin margin is why the farm starves.
